description: This file contains implementations and definitions related to complex number operations, including templates for complex number classes, mathematical functions (norm, conj, proj, polar, log, sqrt, exp, pow, asinh, acosh, atanh, sinh, cosh, tanh, asin, acos, atan, sin, cos, tan), and literal suffixes for complex numbers, specifically tailored for CUDA and LLVM integration.

classes.name: complex
classes.description: Template class for complex numbers supporting various operations and conversions, specialized for float, double, and Half types.

classes.name: complex<at::Half>
classes.description: Specialized complex class for at::Half type with implicit conversions to std::complex<float>.

methods.name: operator""i
methods.description: Literal suffix for creating complex<double> with imaginary part.

methods.name: operator""if
methods.description: Literal suffix for creating complex<float> with imaginary part.
